d: Jharkhand Assembly Special Session : jharkhand vidhanasbha ka do divsiy vishesh satr aaj se shuru ho raha hai. vishesh satr men MMDR sanshodhan aur SIR ke mudde par sadan men satta paksh aur vipaksh ke bich tikhi bahas hone ke aasar hain. satr shuru hone se pahle hi pradesh men siyasi sargarmi tej ho gaee hai. SIR ko lekar matdataon ke adhikar, votar list aur prakriya men kathit garabriyon ka mudda vipaksh sadan men uthane ki taiyari men hai. vahin, MMDR ke mudde par bhi sarkar ko gherne ki ranniti banaee ja rahi hai. aise men vishesh satr ke dauran sadan men jordar bahas aur rajnitik…
